answer: A sybil tax makes bulk forgery a losing trade. Each agent plants one identity in the shared orchard, paying a 50 POA tax that is burned, never refunded. Each job is sealed with a rotating cipher, so peers verify work, not claims. Forging 100 fakes costs 5,000 POA, while each fake earns at most 20 POA before detection, a loss of 3,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full income, one tree on a flat mesa bearing fruit as fakes wither.
